stories.headline: Man seriusly injured in Haifa crime-related stabbing as police search for suspect
stories.summary: Police arrested a suspect after a man was seriously stabbed in Haifa. In Tel Aviv, a suspect was detained with a flare and a screwdriver ahead of a soccer game.

stories.headline: Pro-War Blogger Vanishes From Public After Telegram Post About Oleshky Evacuation
stories.summary: Vladimir Romanov posted and then later deleted a message on his channel that said only four buses filled with residents from Oleshky had departed for Russia during the ceasefire, as opposed to 17 buses that carried evacuees to Ukrainian territory.

stories.headline: Trump Meets Privately With Putin Envoy After White House Event Marking Oleshky Ceasefire
stories.summary: The U.S. president did not disclose what he discussed with envoy Kirill Dmitriev, but he predicted a deal to end the war in Ukraine could emerge soon.

stories.headline: Ukraine and Russia Trade Volley of Strikes Against Each Other’s Energy Infrastructure
stories.summary: In the southern Krasnodar region, drone debris was reported to have crashed into the Afipsky oil refinery and sparked a fire.

stories.headline: Kremlin Accuses Europe of Struggling to Decide Who Will Represent It in Future Security Talks
stories.summary: Spokesman Dmitry Peskov said messaging from officials in Brussels suggests that Europe is still unwilling to engage with Russia in serious discussions.

stories.headline: Rare Thundersnow Strikes Ural Mountains, Ripping Off Roofs and Causing Power Outages
stories.summary: At least one person was reportedly killed in a highway traffic accident in the Sverdlovsk region on Friday morning due to icy road conditions.

stories.headline: Communist Lawmaker Slams Culture Ministry Over Lenin Library Rave
stories.summary: The Russian State Library, popularly known as “Leninka,” hosted the literary-themed rave on Halloween together with Russia’s largest publishing group.

stories.headline: Father and Daughter Who Fled Russia Win Magnitsky Human Rights Award
stories.summary: The organization behind the annual honor said the Moskalyovs received the “Courage Under Fire” award for their refusal to remain silent in the face of state prosecution.

stories.headline: Russian Security Council Calls for Rapid Deployment of Starlink Rival Satellites
stories.summary: A group of experts on the council warned that Elon Musk's satellite network could be used to destabilize countries throughout the world.

stories.headline: Anti-Kremlin Political Parties Peaceful Russia and Rassvet Named ‘Foreign Agents’
stories.summary: Rassvet, founded by 2024 presidential hopeful Yekaterina Duntsova, denied allegations that it received foreign funding.
